descriptor.retrieval_description: Soft cylindrical paper product with a dry, textured fibrous surface and continuous curvature. The intended contact region is compressible, cylindrical, and features a slight edge seam from the loose outer ply.
descriptor.contact_region: Opposing lateral exterior cylindrical surface patches of the toilet paper roll.
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Dry, clean, and textured with fine embossing patterns.
descriptor.local_geometry: Cylindrical curvature with a compressible structure and a minor surface interruption from the loose edge of the outer ply.
descriptor.uncertainty: The exact internal density and compressibility of the paper roll cannot be fully determined from visual inspection alone.
